subject: Food Truck Ordinance
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to discuss a proposed food truck ordinance with city staff and representatives from the Medford Chamber of Commerce. The committee voted to narrow the draft ordinance to focus on single-day and special event licenses and referred the paper to the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules.

items.title: Proposed Food Truck Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed a draft food truck ordinance with city staff and Chamber of Commerce representatives, focusing on protecting brick-and-mortar businesses and streamlining event permitting. The committee voted to limit the proposed ordinance to one-day and special event licenses, request department and Chamber feedback, add penalties for operating without a permit, and refer the paper to the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules.
